cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: At CyberPips, we use cookies and similar technologies to ensure our website operates efficiently, securely, and delivers the best possible user experience. This Cookies Policy explains what cookies are, why we use them, and how you can control their use. By continuing to browse or use our website, you acknowledge and agree to the use of cookies as described in this policy.

what.title: What Are Cookies?
what.text: Cookies are small data files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or mobile phone) when you visit a website. They help websites remember information about your visit, such as preferences or login status, to improve functionality and performance. Cookies do not usually identify you personally; however, in some cases, cookie-related data may be linked to personal information processed by CyberPips in accordance with our Privacy Policy. CyberPips does not store sensitive data such as passwords, payment details, or private credentials inside cookies.

why.title: How CyberPips Uses Cookies
why.one: To ensure the website functions correctly, including secure access, session management, and protection against fraudulent activity
why.two: To improve performance and stability by analyzing website usage and optimizing content
why.three: To remember user preferences, enhance security, prevent abuse, and support marketing and advertising efforts where applicable

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.text: These cookies are required for the website to operate properly. They enable core functions such as secure access, session management, and protection against fraudulent activity. Without these cookies, certain services cannot be provided.

preference.title: Preference Cookies
preference.text: These cookies store your selected preferences, such as language or interface settings, so you do not need to reconfigure them on every visit.

analytics.title: Analytics & Performance Cookies
analytics.text: These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the website by collecting anonymous or aggregated data. This information allows us to improve site performance, usability, and content.

advertising.title: Advertising & Targeting Cookies
advertising.text: These cookies may be used to display advertisements that are more relevant to your interests. They track browsing behavior across websites and may be placed by third-party advertising partners with our permission.

social.title: Social Media Cookies
social.text: When you interact with social features such as sharing content, third-party platforms may place cookies on your device to enable those features and track engagement.

management.title: Managing Your Cookie Preferences
management.text: You are free to control or disable cookies at any time through your browser settings and may also delete cookies that are already stored on your device. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality and limit access to some features.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.text: Some cookies used on the CyberPips website are placed by trusted third-party services such as analytics or advertising providers. These third parties are responsible for their own cookies and privacy practices.

updates.title: Updates to This Cookies Policy
updates.text: CyberPips may update this Cookies Policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, legal requirements, or business practices. Any updates will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.

Nothing on this platform should be interpreted as financial, investment, trading, legal, or tax advice.
